objects.description: [DarkGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1111) queries system locale information during execution.(Citation: Ensilo Darkgate 2018) Later versions of [DarkGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1111) query GetSystemDefaultLCID for locale information to determine if the malware is executing in Russian-speaking countries.(Citation: Trellix Darkgate 2023)
